    The independent and production bound-quiver presentations agree #

    The free path categories, generated ideals, and quotient linear structures agree definitionally. Evaluating at a stationary path identifies the path coordinates. Uniqueness of a finite direct sum identifies the category algebras, giving explicit translations in both directions.
